build_tts_model: build a TTSModel that loads Fairseq Fastspeech2 and HiFi-GAN vocoder from HuggingFace Hub for CPU inference
synthesize_text_to_speech: synthesize text into audio waveform samples and sample rate using the TTSModel synthesize method
run_speech_counter_agent: run the EnglishSpeechCounter speech-to-speech agent with configurable wait-seconds argument via simuleval CLI
configure_agent_policy: configure the EnglishSpeechCounter policy to read audio chunks until wait-seconds threshold then write synthesized speech
create_speech_segment: create a SpeechSegment with audio content, sample rate, and finished flag for speech-to-speech agent output
